home.hero_desc: Empire Hotel offers world-class hospitality in the historic city of Frýdek-Místek, Czech Republic.
home.welcome_text: Nestled in the charming city of Frýdek-Místek, Empire Hotel blends timeless elegance with modern comfort. Whether you are here for business or leisure, our dedicated team ensures an unforgettable stay.
home.h1_desc: Situated in the heart of Frýdek-Místek, steps away from historic landmarks, restaurants, and shopping.
home.h2_desc: Each room is designed with meticulous attention to detail, offering the finest bedding and modern amenities.
home.h3_desc: Our professional staff is available 24/7 to fulfill your every need and make your stay extraordinary.
home.h4_desc: Savor exquisite cuisine at our in-house restaurant, featuring both Czech specialties and international dishes.

rooms.title: Our Rooms
rooms.subtitle: Each room is thoughtfully designed to provide maximum comfort and elegance during your stay.
rooms.room1_desc: Comfortable and elegantly furnished room with two single beds (sleeps up to 2), a work desk, and city view. The beds can be joined together or kept separate upon request.
rooms.room2_desc: Spacious room with premium furnishings, king-size bed, sitting area, and panoramic views.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Everything you need for a perfect stay, all under one roof.
facilities.f1_desc: Breakfast and dinner are served as Korean cuisine.
facilities.f2_desc: Stay healthy at our fitness center equipped with exercise equipment.
facilities.f3_desc: Convenient car rental service available for guests.
facilities.f4_desc: Enjoy a fun night in at our on-site karaoke room, available for all guests.
facilities.f5_desc: Parking is available for all hotel guests.

contact.title: Contact & Booking
